description: The Bahmni Appointments module shows three patients — Emily Chen (BAH000011), Rosa Martinez (BAH000010), and Priya Patel (BAH000005) — all scheduled for the General OPD clinic at exactly the same time slot tomorrow morning. This creates an overbooking conflict that must be resolved before the clinic opens. Access Bahmni at https://localhost/bahmni/home (login: superman / Admin123). Your task as the clinic coordinator is to: (1) identify all three conflicting appointments in the Appointments module, (2) reschedule Emily Chen's appointment to a time slot 1 hour later than the original conflicting time, (3) reschedule Rosa Martinez's appointment to a time slot 2 hours later than the original conflicting time, (4) keep Priya Patel's appointment at the original time slot as she arrived first, and (5) add a note or comment to each rescheduled appointment documenting the reason for the change. All three appointments must end up at different time slots.
